# FG-REVIEW-0028

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`auto-merge`](../../ops/runbooks/auto-merge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_scan_failure_is_logged_with_its_cause` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自動マージの確認に失敗しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: Checking merge requests for auto-merge failed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pemeriksaan merge request untuk merge otomatis gagal. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C9: the auto-merge worker in `forge serve` could not decide a merge request (reading its facts from the database, its check runs, or the changed paths from git failed or timed out) for longer than one failure streak, so merge requests of `full` / `conditional` projects are not being queued automatically. Nothing was merged or queued by the failed step; people can still merge.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs `forge.auto_merge.scan_failed` (error) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `cause_code` (the underlying FG code: FG-DB-*, FG-GIT-*), `project_id`, `merge_request_id` and `streak`. Look up `cause_code` in the catalog; `forge doctor` shows the database and storage checks.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook auto-merge: fix the underlying cause (database or git storage, see `cause_code`); the worker retries with backoff and continues by itself. If it must not act meanwhile, turn the instance emergency stop on.
